summary: All 29 source files passed integrity checks, and all nine computations reproduced. The 13,408 paired effects cover 76.63% of the registered output, below the 90% requirement. The corrected proposal distinguishes Figure 8b’s 2,165 red tanycyte discoveries from its 5,126 other discoveries in blue and documents a genotype-label discrepancy in all seven registered libraries. The needs_author_contact closure remains justified. The corrected proposal passed validation.
openIssues: The original DESeq2 fitting cohort, pool terms, normalization, offsets and filtering order remain unresolved.
The seven library assignments match, but their GEO genotype field reads IRmKate2 while the TRAP methods describe Cre-treated IRwt/wt reporter controls.
The historical filter replay accounts for 29 of 32 absent author discoveries. The remaining three predecessor IDs are unverified.
